data.title: Eberconazole 1% cream
data.summary: I Antifungals — Azoles · Imidazole antifungal (newer, broad spectrum)
data.body:
_Topicals · I Antifungals — Azoles_

**Class:** Imidazole antifungal (newer, broad spectrum)

## Mechanism of action
- Inhibits ergosterol synthesis (14-α-demethylase)
- Also active against some Gram-positive bacteria and has anti-inflammatory activity (inhibits 5-lipoxygenase, cyclo-oxygenase)
- Useful in inflamed or secondarily infected tinea

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Tinea corporis, cruris, pedis; cutaneous candidiasis; pityriasis versicolor
- Inflamed/infected dermatophytosis (possibly avoiding steroid combinations)

## Dose & formulations
- Apply twice daily for 4 weeks (or 2 weeks after clinical cure)

## Adverse effects
- Mild burning, itching, erythema

## Contraindications
- Hypersensitivity to imidazoles

## Pregnancy & lactation
Limited data; avoid unless needed.

## Viva points
- Antifungal + antibacterial + anti-inflammatory
- Developed in Spain; widely marketed in India

## Note on sources
Eberconazole is in neither book; product data and published trials were used.

_Sources: Not covered in Wolverton or Khopkar; product information and published trials. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
